items.t: Brands Don’t Need Millions of Followers to Succeed—Here’s Why
items.sum: Creators with small followings can sometimes generate more sales than influencers with millions of followers. Oshiya Savur, CMO of e.l.f. Beauty, and Bob Sherwin, CMO of Staples, discuss how brands are rethinking the importance of follower counts and their own corporate social media accounts. They spoke with the WSJ Leadership Institute’s Katie Deighton at the WSJLI CMO Council Summit in New York.
